Can you reveal the paid subscription model of adult websites?

Yes. Many paid subscription sites use a similar structure:

1) Access levels  
- Visitors can view a limited preview.  
- Subscribers pay to unlock full access.

2) Billing methods  
- Monthly or yearly plans are common.  
- Some offer one-time purchases for specific items.

3) Renewal and cancellation
